notice:
## SysML participating-installation analytics
Counts describe random, locally persisted installation IDs participating in usage telemetry, **not people, accounts, total installs, or successful unique users**. IDs reset on usage opt-out; sessions are per activation, not visits. No machine/account/email/workspace identity is collected.

All charts use schema 2 and the selected dates/version/host, limited to the retained last 90 days. Empty charts do not prove health or zero activity. Consent, offline loss, client rate caps, concurrency limits, dropped events, schema filtering, ingestion caps/delay and spoofed public traffic bias the results; missing activity cannot be reconstructed. Sequence gaps are not a count of dropped events. Distinct estimates use dcount accuracy 2 where marked approximate. Nothing is sampling-extrapolated.

Usage outcome rates share an operation-event denominator. Standalone sysml.error records include the separate error-only-consent population, contain no IDs, and are never divided by usage or joined into journeys. Completed activation latency provides no failed-boot denominator.

parameters.name: Version
parameters.label: Extension version
parameters.query:
TimeEvents
| where '{Host:escape}' == '*' or tostring(Properties.host) == '{Host:escape}'
| distinct value = tostring(Properties.extensionVersion)
| project value, label = value, selected = false
| union (datatable(value:string, label:string, selected:bool)['*', 'All versions', true])
| order by selected desc, value asc

sessionParameter.name: Session
sessionParameter.label: Journey session (latest 100 matching sessions)
sessionParameter.query:
CorrelatedUsage
| summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by SessionId
| top 100 by LastSeen desc
| project value = SessionId, label = strcat(format_datetime(LastSeen, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), ' UTC / ', SessionId), selected = false
| union (datatable(value:string, label:string, selected:bool)['none', 'Select a session', true])
| order by selected desc, label desc

queries.title: Active participating installations and observed sessions
queries.description: DAU/WAU/MAU are trailing 24-hour/7-day/30-day counts ending at the selected end, intersected with the selected dates and retention. Window-complete flags describe date coverage only, not delivery completeness. Any received usage event qualifies, regardless of outcome; error-only events do not.
queries.query:
let SessionCount = toscalar(CorrelatedUsage | summarize by SessionId | count);
CorrelatedUsage
| summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by UserId
| summarize ActiveInstallations = count(), DAU = countif(LastSeen > WindowEnd - 1d), WAU = countif(LastSeen > WindowEnd - 7d), MAU = countif(LastSeen > WindowEnd - 30d)
| extend Sessions = SessionCount, SelectedStart = WindowStart, SelectedEnd = WindowEnd,
    DAUWindowComplete = WindowStart <= WindowEnd - 1d, WAUWindowComplete = WindowStart <= WindowEnd - 7d, MAUWindowComplete = WindowStart <= WindowEnd - 30d

queries.title: Daily participating installations and sessions (approximate)
queries.description: UTC calendar days; boundary days can be partial. Zero means no retained matching events, not confirmed inactivity. These daily counts are not summed to obtain WAU/MAU.
queries.query:
range Day from startofday(WindowStart) to startofday(WindowEnd) step 1d
| where WindowStart <= WindowEnd
| join kind=leftouter (CorrelatedUsage | summarize Installations = dcount(UserId, 2), Sessions = dcount(SessionId, 2) by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)) on Day
| project Day, Installations = coalesce(Installations, 0), Sessions = coalesce(Sessions, 0)
| order by Day asc

queries.title: Returning installations within the selected window
queries.description: Returning means observed in BOTH equal halves of this date selection, under the same version/host filters. The percentage is returning / second-half active installations. Second-half-only does NOT mean first-ever or newly installed; history before this window is unknown, and opt-out resets identity.
queries.query:
let Midpoint = WindowStart + (WindowEnd - WindowStart) / 2;
CorrelatedUsage
| summarize EarlierEvents = countif(TimeGenerated < Midpoint), LaterEvents = countif(TimeGenerated >= Midpoint) by UserId
| summarize FirstHalfActive = countif(EarlierEvents > 0), SecondHalfActive = countif(LaterEvents > 0), Returning = countif(EarlierEvents > 0 and LaterEvents > 0), SecondHalfOnly = countif(EarlierEvents == 0 and LaterEvents > 0)
| extend ReturningPctOfSecondHalf = iif(SecondHalfActive == 0, real(null), 100.0 * Returning / SecondHalfActive), SplitAt = Midpoint

queries.title: Observed sessions: event frequency and observed span
queries.description: A session is a random per-activation ID, not a visit or person. Span is last minus first received client timestamp inside the filters; it is NOT active time, uptime, or completed session duration. Single-event sessions have zero span.
queries.query:
CorrelatedUsage
| summarize UsageRecords = count(), FirstObserved = min(TimeGenerated), LastObserved = max(TimeGenerated) by SessionId
| extend ObservedSpanMs = datetime_diff('millisecond', LastObserved, FirstObserved)
| summarize Sessions = count(), SingleRecordSessions = countif(UsageRecords == 1), P50Records = percentile(UsageRecords, 50), P95Records = percentile(UsageRecords, 95), P50ObservedSpanMs = percentile(ObservedSpanMs, 50), P95ObservedSpanMs = percentile(ObservedSpanMs, 95)

queries.title: Observed sessions per participating installation
queries.description: Distribution within this window, including all usage outcomes. No raw installation IDs are displayed.
queries.query:
CorrelatedUsage
| summarize by UserId, SessionId
| summarize Sessions = count() by UserId
| summarize Installations = count() by Sessions
| order by Sessions asc

queries.title: Feature reach and frequency (approximate distinct counts)
queries.description: Features are named operation/action/view combinations or panel-open events, not deduplicated user interactions. Panel-open and operation-open are separate signals. Reach uses ALL correlated usage installations/sessions in this selection as its denominator. Frequency is received feature records per installation that used that feature, including every outcome.

queries.title: Feature frequency in sessions that used it
queries.description: Each observation is one feature/session pair; sessions without that feature are excluded from these frequency percentiles. Use session reach above for the all-session denominator.
queries.query:
FeatureEvents
| summarize FeatureRecords = count() by Feature, SessionId
| summarize SessionsWithFeature = count(), MeanRecords = avg(FeatureRecords), P50Records = percentile(FeatureRecords, 50), P95Records = percentile(FeatureRecords, 95), P99Records = percentile(FeatureRecords, 99) by Feature
| order by SessionsWithFeature desc

queries.title: Common next observed feature transitions (top 25)
queries.description: Pairs are ordered numerically by sequence WITHIN a random SessionId, not by arrival time, and are aggregated before display. Ambiguous duplicate sequence positions are excluded. WithSequenceGaps can reflect omitted activation records, filtering or loss; it cannot measure dropped events. Next observed does not imply an uninterrupted or causal journey. Sessions is approximate.
queries.query:
FeatureEvents
| summarize Copies = count(), Feature = take_any(Feature) by SessionId, Sequence
| where Copies == 1
| sort by SessionId asc, Sequence asc
| serialize
| extend NextSession = next(SessionId), NextFeature = next(Feature), NextSequence = next(Sequence)
| where NextSession == SessionId and NextSequence > Sequence
| summarize Transitions = count(), Sessions = dcount(SessionId, 2), WithSequenceGaps = countif(NextSequence > Sequence + 1) by FromFeature = Feature, ToFeature = NextFeature
| top 25 by Transitions desc

queries.title: Selected session: sequence-ordered usage records (first 500)
queries.description: Choose a random session ID above. The picker lists the latest 100 sessions matching dates/version/host; the same filters apply here. No installation IDs or standalone error records are displayed. Missing sequence positions and repeated positions are not silently repaired. A retained operation failure can appear; an anonymous sysml.error cannot be joined to it.
queries.query:
CorrelatedUsage
| where SessionId == '{Session:escape}'
| project Sequence = tolong(Measurements.sequence), TimeGenerated, Name, Panel = tostring(Properties.panel), Action = tostring(Properties.action), View = tostring(Properties.view), Outcome = tostring(Properties.outcome), DurationMs = todouble(Measurements.durationMs), Version = tostring(Properties.extensionVersion), Host = tostring(Properties.host)
| order by Sequence asc, TimeGenerated asc
| take 500

queries.title: Client-reported latency by operation, outcome and version (ms)
queries.description: P50/P95/P99 include only reported, bounded durations. Samples and small-sample flags remain visible. Outcome separation avoids mixing successful work with cancellations/rejections/failures. Activated records measure completed activation only; absent or failed boots are not inferred.
queries.query:
UsageEvents
| where Name == 'sysml.extension.activated' or Name endswith '.operation'
| extend DurationMs = todouble(Measurements.durationMs), Operation = iif(Name == 'sysml.extension.activated', 'completed-activation', tostring(Properties.action)), Outcome = tostring(Properties.outcome), Version = tostring(Properties.extensionVersion)
| where isfinite(DurationMs) and DurationMs >= 0 and DurationMs <= 3600000
| summarize Samples = count(), P50Ms = percentile(DurationMs, 50), P95Ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95), P99Ms = percentile(DurationMs, 99) by Name, Operation, Outcome, Version
| extend SmallSample = Samples < 100
| order by Name asc, Operation asc, Version asc, Outcome asc

queries.title: Usage operation outcomes: common denominator per operation/version
queries.description: Each rate uses all retained usage operation records for the SAME operation and version, across success/failure/rejected/cancelled. These are reported-operation rates, not attempted-operation or boot-failure rates. sysml.error is explicitly excluded, including error-only-consent records. Missing usage is unknown, not success.
queries.query:
UsageEvents
| where Name endswith '.operation'
| summarize Operations = count(), Successes = countif(tostring(Properties.outcome) == 'success'), Failures = countif(tostring(Properties.outcome) == 'failure'), Rejections = countif(tostring(Properties.outcome) == 'rejected'), Cancellations = countif(tostring(Properties.outcome) == 'cancelled') by Name, Action = tostring(Properties.action), Version = tostring(Properties.extensionVersion)
| extend FailurePct = 100.0 * Failures / Operations, RejectionPct = 100.0 * Rejections / Operations, CancellationPct = 100.0 * Cancellations / Operations, SuccessPct = 100.0 * Successes / Operations
| order by Operations desc

queries.title: Standalone error codes: separate error-consent population
queries.description: Volume only. Includes installations permitting errors but NOT usage, as well as errors from usage participants; those populations cannot be separated because errors never carry IDs. Not an affected-installation count, usage failure rate, or failed-boot rate.
queries.query:
Events
| where Name == 'sysml.error'
| summarize ErrorRecords = count() by Component = tostring(Properties.component), Operation = tostring(Properties.operation), Code = tostring(Properties.code), Version = tostring(Properties.extensionVersion), Host = tostring(Properties.host)
| order by ErrorRecords desc

queries.title: Filtered retained-event health and ingestion lag
queries.description: Only stored schema-2 rows can be assessed. Uncorrelated usage is retained but excluded from installation/session/journey metrics. ErrorIdentityViolations should be zero; any nonzero value blocks collection. Reported ingestion lag includes client clock skew. No stored query can count pre-ingestion/schema/rate-cap drops or consent-disabled activity.
queries.query:
Events
| extend IsUsage = Name != 'sysml.error', IngestionLagMs = datetime_diff('millisecond', ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated)
| summarize RetainedRecords = count(), UsageRecords = countif(IsUsage), UncorrelatedUsage = countif(IsUsage and (isempty(UserId) or isempty(SessionId) or isnull(tolong(Measurements.sequence)))), ErrorRecords = countif(not(IsUsage)), ErrorIdentityViolations = countif(not(IsUsage) and (isnotempty(UserId) or isnotempty(SessionId) or isnotnull(Measurements.sequence))), LastEvent = max(TimeGenerated), LastIngested = max(ingestion_time()), P50LagMs = percentile(IngestionLagMs, 50), P95LagMs = percentile(IngestionLagMs, 95)
| extend MinutesSinceLastIngestion = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastIngested)

queries.title: Duplicate usage sequence positions
queries.description: Repeated SessionId/sequence positions are ambiguous and excluded from common transitions. This aggregate is not a replay detector or proof of source authenticity; random-looking public-ingestion payloads can be spoofed.
queries.query:
CorrelatedUsage
| summarize Copies = count() by SessionId, Sequence = tolong(Measurements.sequence)
| summarize SequencePositions = count(), DuplicatePositions = countif(Copies > 1), ExtraCopies = sum(Copies - 1)

queries.title: Filtered retained AppEvents billable MB per day
queries.description: Respects version/host filters using stored AppEvents billing metadata. Excludes other tables, rejected data, transformation processing and fixed alert costs; NOT total workspace ingestion, real-time spend, or a cap/budget guarantee. Existing 80 MB workspace alerts and the combined budget remain separate controls.
queries.query:
Events
| where _IsBillable == 'true'
| summarize RetainedBillableMB = sum(_BilledSize) / 1000000.0 by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by Day asc

queries.title: Workspace cap interruptions (All versions / All hosts only)
queries.description: Workspace operational records cannot be attributed to an extension version or host. This panel is intentionally suppressed unless BOTH filters are All, and always respects the dates and 30-day query bound. Empty results are not proof that no cap or other ingestion loss occurred; operational logs can lag.
queries.query:
_LogOperation
| where TimeGenerated >= WindowStart and TimeGenerated <= WindowEnd
| where '{Version:escape}' == '*' and '{Host:escape}' == '*'
| where Category =~ 'Ingestion' and Detail contains 'OverQuota'
| summarize Interruptions = count() by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by Day desc
